reviews.text: I cannot thank Dr. Martinez and the entire team at West Alabama enough for the care they provided my pup. Even though she is not a patient there, they provided the emergent care she needed and helped to expedite the emergency surgery she required. Thanks to their quick action, Charmaine is doing great.

We have been clients of West Alabama Animal Clinic for over 7 years and have always been pleased with the care they have provided our dog. Just today our dog had sutures quickly removed by their friendly staff and I was once again impressed by the staffs' positive work ethic. 10/10 recommend.

My baby’s eye all of the sudden became bright red. I was able to contact this location and send them pictures. They made room for Max and put me at ease. I was a frantic mess when I took him in but they were able to refer an optometrist. I am so grateful for this staff and the amazing doctors. I will never go anywhere else for my baby. The team here was so patient and informative. I am just so grateful to have this animal clinic. 10000/10. Kelly was so great along with the whole team. I’ve been to a few clinics in the area but they have not met the standards that West Alabama has.
It was our 1st appointment. Dr Martinez actually listened to me and understood my little Abby's lifestyle. This is SO refreshing and totally appreciated.
Very responsive! Getting care for my poop challenged pup has been easy.

Small clinic, they have a cat sign, and a dog side. Confidence staff, very caring very kind people know what they're doing and care that you get the best service. They can give you, it is not an emergency runaround center, but it's a lovely place to go and have your pet cared for it. A reasonable price with competent people who care

I appreciate the staff at West Alabama Animal Clinic - everyone is always really sweet and accommodating. My dog has a lot of anxiety and it can be stressful for everyone, but they always handle it really well. They're willing to work with you for whatever you need, which is refreshing. Everyone I've interacted with there has always been pleasant :)
Highly recommended! They always treated us very kind and profesional, we love it.
The girls at the reception have a really bad mood and she doesn’t have any education.

I have been a client at West Alabama Animal Clinic for many years. Their pricing has generally felt fair for the area. In one instance, tests were run on on of my dogs without prior authorization; while the clinic did ultimately refund those charges (which I appreciated), standard practice should require discussing and approving costs in advance.

The most disappointing experience, however, was during my senior dog’s final illness. When he became critically ill, I reached out seeking care but was told they were fully booked and could not see him. We sought care elsewhere, where his condition was promptly assessed and a clear treatment plan was provided. Shortly after, we had to make the difficult decision to euthanize him.

What compounded our grief was the lack of follow-up or acknowledgment. There was no check-in after referring us elsewhere, no expression of sympathy after being notified of his passing, and we later received an automated vaccine reminder for a dog who was no longer alive.

After nearly a decade as a client, I expected clearer communication and greater compassion during such a difficult time.

I found them when I had to put my beloved Kiki down. He had been to two other vets that basically tortured him with bad  treatments, not being sterile before examining him, cutting off the circulation to his leg, etc.  My baby became blind & had a huge infection in his mouth that would have required me to pump him full of meds, surgery & eye removal. I just couldn't do it. He was 14yrs old. He deserved peace.
Dr. Danielle Maislos & the vet tech I met at the West Alabama Animal Clinic were the most compassionate people I had met during Kiki's illness journey & it was because of them that I knew I was in a place where Kiki could cross rainbow bridge surrounded by people who truly loved their jobs and the animals that come through their doors. They gave me all the time I needed to say goodbye & hold him when it was over. Their compassion knows no bounds and I'm glad that the Lord lead me to them so that Kiki's last hours weren't in pain and suffering; he was loved, held and now with his brother and I will see him again. 💔
I may have met them during heartache, but I have finally found a new vet for my other furbabies. Thank you to everyone that made that process so much easier. From letting him go, picking out his urn & picking up his ashes & putting on his name plate on his urn (that was tricky!), everyone has been more than helpful than any other vet Kiki saw during his illness.
We love Dr. Dany! They’re always so great for our annual exam & so nice & helpful.

I unfortunately had to move my vet closer to home bc with a new baby in the way, life is bound to get more hectic. I used to live closer to this location and when I moved away, continued to bring all 3 pets here bc I love the service, staff, and doctors at West Alabama. And cats are not as mobile but I continued to do so. Usually we are seen promptly, they have an app that I can chat with their staff to and have access to my pets records. And all the docs are lovely. It’s overall been a great experience and I’m sad to leave this clinic. Thank you West Alabama Animal Clinic for taking care of my fur babies!
We loved West Alabama for many years (for both our dog and cats) when we lived in the area!

I haven’t been part of the WAAC family for long, but they’ve made me feel incredibly welcome from the start. I had brought my dog in for visits, but never my cat—she was 18 years old and just peacefully living out her final chapter.

A couple of weeks ago, she passed away, and I brought her to WAAC to be cremated. Even though she had never been a patient there, the team treated her as if she had been part of their care for years. They handled everything with such compassion and respect.

A few days later, I received a handwritten sympathy card in the mail—a small gesture that meant so much. It reminded me that true care isn’t limited to records or appointments. Even in goodbye, they treated her like one of their own.

I will always remember that and recommend them to others!

Thank you, WAAC.
Trust this place with all of my fur babies
Got our international travel clearance for our Anzu pup here. Great experience!

The WAAC team is great to work with and by using their message portal for existing patients, it’s always easy to get in contact with them where there is something going on. They make the appointments easy by scheduling set times or drop-offs that work with your schedule. It has been wonderful working with Dr Dany who always takes the time to answer your question and doesn’t rush out of the room. My pup Topo is not scared of the vet and that is thanks to their care.

The staff was warm and welcoming, and the clinic was clean and comfortable. Our vet and tech were so gentle with Emmy and explained everything clearly, which really put me at ease. We’re so happy to be part of this clinic!
Great service.  Excellent vets.  Highly recommend
Efficient and kind!

Dr. Rosser and Martinez were more than exceptional regarding the care of my cats for the past 10 or so years.  Today I will pick up the fourth cat they have taken care of for me.  They have been detailed and informative regarding her delicate care involving and advising me to make the proper decisions.  I am grateful to have my pets receive this higher level of care. They definitely deserve five stars and I highly recommend this group of veteneriants led by the owner Dr. Rosser.

Previous review (5 stars). The doctor was super friendly and treated our cat just like her own.  I definitely recommend this place.
New review: we got a prescription for Revolution Plus for around $50. It was supposed to be for 3 month supply. We ordered from Petsmart on the 27th or 28th of April. They didn't get to it until May. So they said they can only give us 2 months' supply. We thought it was unfair and asked for a full refund for the prescription. They said they would refund us as long as we showed them a receipt. But most of the time, we don't even get a receipt most of the time.
Quick and easy puppy check up appointment.  Helpful and very friendly staff.
Great staff
The whole staff was kind and knowledgeable.  I felt that Gingersnap was in good hands.

West Alabama Clinic has been taking care of my cats for years. They are so kind and knowledgeable. They don’t judge when I struggle as a cat parent and consistently guide me towards a better life for my pets. The cats are always visibly happier after a visit (even the rough ones). I wouldn’t trust anyone else from grooming to surgeries.

All the veterinarians at west alabama animal clinic are fantastic. Piper suffers from environmental allergies and we have been in quite often lately trying to resolve. They do a great job with her and always help us to resolve any issues. My only complaint would be the front desk staff. They are unorganized resulting on me dealing with incomplete billings issues on more than one occasion. Most recently (4/10) i brought piper in for a visit and upon check out i was told i had an unsatisfied balance of $298 from February! The card exp date was entered incorrectly and therefore declined when they ran the transaction. Nobody from the team thought to reach out at any point between February and April to resolve…however felt that it was appropriate to have me settle an $800 balance that day due to their mistake. Last year (3/8/24) piper had small mass removed from her head along with a tooth cleaning in which they forgot to charge the card all together. This particular time they did finally reach out…(two weeks later). This is a huge inconvenience that , in my opinion, is completely avoidable.
Everyone at west Alabama animal clinician houston tx. Is sweet, kind, caring,amazing,& very helpful. They take wonderful care of your pet. I give them 10 stars.
Very friendly. Treat pets like family.

I’ve been bringing my cats here for more than 20 years. Clinic is always clean and I like the separate entrances for dogs and cats. The support staff is helpful, professional and friendly. The vet staff are always attentive and answer questions completely. While my cats hate vet visits, the staff is always compassionate and gentle, so my cats are minimally stressed.
Very pleased with the care received and the responsive staff. I trust WAAC with all my fur babies.

I brought my new rescue here for a new patient appointment. I was happy they had some slots available (reason for the 2 stars) though I had to ask 3 different times before someone said they did have appointments. Their website states you get a free exam ($60 value) for rescuing a dog. I confirmed this twice prior to the appointment and just before he was seen yet I didn’t get the free exam.

It was spring break so understandably busy and I didn’t mind the wait. However, the doctor kept leaving the room saying she was going to “review his records” when I could hear her attending to other pets. She expressed one’s anal glands, saw another. Finally she came and stayed in our room with his records in hand, reviewing them during the visit without much to say. Despite him having the bordetella vaccine a month ago she said he was due again though he isn’t a puppy.

I told her he was my first dog and would appreciate advice on specifically a mini poodle and dog in general. Everything I asked she said “yeah that’s fine.” Is a cup twice a day a good amount of food? Yeah that’s fine. His head smells I think it’s his ears. He doesn’t smell too bad to me. Should he put on any weight? He’s fine.

The front desk girls were no better. I asked for a note to say I’d been there and the receptionist said they don’t do that. I asked her to ask the doctor and magically I got a note. On my bill only $30 was reduced from the price of the $60 visit instead of it being free as advertised. There were other pricing discrepancies but after arguing for 5 minutes I decided to let it go and I simply won’t return. Aside from a rebate for nexgard plus this was a wasted visit. I learned nothing about my dog, he got an unnecessary vaccine and I had to take him to another vet for proper care.

I have bringing my variety of pets here since 1996. They are fabulous and caring. Some staff members have been there that long too....THAT speaks volumes
Always a good experience. I started with them because they were close. I now live in Cypress and still drive all the way in. Would  not turn my current senior citizen cat to anyone else
Great, caring staff and boarding available. Separate entrances for cats and dogs.
I trust this animal clinic above all. Their compassion is real and the animals they care for are in the best hands.
The best vet care with veterinarians. who take their time and listen. Great front staff and vet tech. the place is awesome.
Always a great experience here. They take great care of my dog and are very easy to work with.

Great staff and amazing doctors! Dr Rosser has been seeing our fur babies forever!
Thank you!
Best place for your pet care

Absolutely the most caring, kind, knowledgeable, financially affordable and excellent veterinarian clinic I have been with since my first dog 35 years ago!!! I have recommended to many friends that have all transferred over and are amazed in the tremendous treatment and care and all the above written. One is completely making or missing such a beautiful lifetime experience in not joining this clinic!!! Kindly, Shellie Robertson.  Lizzie, Peanut is my HEART 🩷🩷🩷
Caring group of staff. Good care
I really like Dr Haffey at WAAC.  She is professional, thorough, and great with my very energetic dog.

This vet clinic is okay overall. I’ve been here 2-3 times, and there are some positives, like their flexibility with scheduling and relatively affordable prices for vaccinations. Most of the staff has been kind to my fur baby and I, which I truly appreciate, and the veterinarian (along with a few of the techs) I’ve interacted with made a good first impression.

However, there are areas that need definite improvement. The administration services are subpar, with little attention to detail when updating client/patient information or invoices. Additionally, some of the vet techs provide minimal information—e.g., if a dog needs to lose weight, it would be helpful to explain how many pounds and offer solutions, rather than simply stating it and walking away. And the poor communication style. They will charge you for procedures but not inform you that there is a deadline, so they try to recharge you again.This comes across as lazy and poor patient care.

Lastly, the Otto app they use is also horrendous. While the clinic has potential, improving communication and administrative efficiency would make a big difference.
I was nervous at first. I wanted a place that I could trust with my baby. Everyone was so kind! My fur baby has found a wonderful caring place.

The Most Amazing Veterinarian!
I cannot say enough great things about West Alabama Animal Clinic. The service has always been exceptional, the pricing fair, and the staff incredibly friendly and professional. I’ve been a loyal client for over 20 years, and they continue to impress me as the best veterinarian I’ve ever worked with.

As someone who has always had dogs and fostered many rescues, I deeply value their understanding, compassion, and expertise in caring for animals. I wholeheartedly recommend West Alabama Animal Clinic to anyone seeking top-notch veterinary care. They truly go above and beyond for pets and their owners!
I live this place,the best services.
Best vet in Houston!

The compassion they show for pets here is unrivaled. West Alabama successfully treated our rescue GSD mix for heart worms. They help us make sure she is at a healthy weight, and they recommend supplements to stave off hip and joint issues that are common in this breed. They also recently helped us with our foster dog who, after years of neglect, needs a lot of TLC. The care with which they treated our foster dog is something I will remember forever. As long as we are in Houston, this will be our vet.
Great place for your pet, awesome staff and convenient hours of service.

If I could give Cendra and her team 10 stars I would! I cannot say enough about how fantastic they were in helping us get our dogs moved over seas. When things went sideways they went out of their way to make sure we were able to get what we needed in time to prevent any changes in travel plans. The office team was incredibly kind and helpful. If you ever need help with an international move or just want to see one of the most friendly vet offices around do not hesitate to check them out.
We love visiting West Alabama Animal Clinic, we always feel very taken care of by the providers who are always there to listen and help with our pet's problems and help to fix it.

West Alabama took wonderful care of my young dog for 3 years. Great in serious situations: found a small tumor quickly and did a wonderful job with surgery, and gave him great care when seriously attacked by another dog. The vets and staff were always very kind and understanding of my dog's nervousness. Only left bc we moved - really highly recommend!
Dr. Haffy is great! She is smart and well versed in emerging veterinary science.

My dog had his first grooming session yesterday. Front desk staff was very friendly. My dog has a history of seizure. Front desk staff immediately acknowledged my concern and informed me that they would put a bell on my dog and put him in a high populated area for close monitoring. I really appreciate it. The groomer called and asked for instructions. She did exactly how I wanted it. My dog looks good. The reason of 4 stars instead of 5 stars is that I wish I got to meet the groomer in person. I understand she’s busy but it’s the first visit. I would like to get to know her and discuss my dog’s needs and behavior, expectations etc. I would like to know how my dog did during the grooming session. Overall it’s a good experience.
Excellent help thank you

They were able to get her in right away. We honestly thought this was the end. But they found an infection and was able to drain it and she was ok. We are very thankful. We had taken her to another vet twice and they did not help her get better. We highly recommend them for your pet’s needs. Very nice staff and understanding.

I just want to share how kind and wonderful the West Alabama animal clinic staff was to me - I brought in a lost dog, and not only did they help me scan for a microchip, but the team went above and beyond to give her an exam, some food, and extra reassurance and support through everything. They're angels, and I definitely will be bringing my kitties here in the future. ❤️
Gentle and kind to my over dramatic husky Stormy. A bit pricey but close by, nice facility, knowledgeable doctors, caring staff overall !!
Amazing staff and fair prices! Definitely my goto vet in Montrose!

The veterinarians and staff at West Alabama Animal clinic provide the highest level of care to be found in the Houston metropolitan area. This is a surgical hospital and veterinary clinic. They can take care of anny small animals, But I have only witnessed dogs and cats personally.
They gave the best care for our cat Sky.
The staff and the vet's are the best I recommend West Alabama Animal Clinic.
I’ve been going here for years and the staff is exceptional, knowledgeable, and very kind.
Great service. Been going here for years for my pups. The only issue is parking
